'''Beryllium''' was a type of valuable [[Ore/Legends|ore]], substantial deposits of which could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Illarreen]] of<ref name="Journal14" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Herios sector/Legends|Herios sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Illarreen system/Legends|Illarreen system]]</ref> After the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Journal14" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> led to the stagnation of the economy of Illarreen's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Poss'Nomin]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the planetary [[Poss'Nomin government]] auctioned off significant expanses of publicly owned land. Those territories were then predominantly purchased by influential offworld [[Mining/Legends|mining]] enterprises, which were interested in Illarreen's beryllium reserves but not in the plight of the Poss'Nomin.<ref name="Journal14" />

==Behind the scenes==
Beryllium was introduced in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise via "[[Alien Encounters (article series)|Alien Encounters]]," a feature written by [[Trevor J. Wilson]] and [[Craig Robert Carey]] and published in the [[August]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 14|fourteenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Journal14" /> In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Beryllium|beryllium]] is a [[Wikipedia:Chemical element|chemical element]] and [[Wikipedia:Metal|metal]]. It does not occur in free form in nature and is instead extracted from [[Wikipedia:Ore|ores]] such as [[Wikipedia:Beryl|beryl]] and [[Wikipedia:Bertrandite|bertrandite]]. Beryllium has a wide range of industrial applications.<ref name="BerylliumBritannica">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/science/beryllium|text=Beryllium &#124; Properties, Uses, & Facts|author=The Editors of Encyclopædia Britannica|date=2025-01-31|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20250130123635}}</ref>
